name: Employer-Sponsored Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: A work visa and a separate work permit are both required, applied for either directly through a Syrian consulate/embassy abroad or alongside the employment contract once in Syria. Permits are employer-specific and typically issued for 1 year, renewable.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a Syrian employment contract, then apply for the work visa/permit through a Syrian consulate or with the employer in-country.

requirements.blocker_text: Employers must generally demonstrate no qualified Syrian national is available for the role. Sectors reported as having more openings for foreign workers include humanitarian aid, construction, and education, reflecting current reconstruction-era demand.
requirements.fix_path: Employer must document the absence of a qualified Syrian candidate for the role.

sources.title: Multiplier (private EOR/HR-guide site) -- work permit and work visa process, employer-specific issuance, and 1-year renewable duration

LawGratis (private legal-guide site) -- Syria's residency permit categories including employment-based temporary residence, the labor-market-test requirement, and sectors with more foreign-worker demand
